All of that, and I actually paid someone else and I needed a bit of money and we got our first internet page job or website shall I say and um after a few days it was doing quite well.  It wasn't selling.  It was no e commerce on there.  It was purely to get people to the shop to see what we sold so they could phone us, email us and all that sort of thing.  But within about two years that was fifty percent of my business was online.  Now all my other friends were opening up multiple shops going to different locations and they thought they were doing all right and for us time they were until they weren't until the high street started back in away because what I'd Scene was the opportunities were where the customers were going to be, not where they'd been for fifty years that was changing it's where they're going to be, and I think that's always worth having that in mind where your customers gonna be in the future, and I think there's two very important lessons, and I think it's like.
